decisions.rationale: Drug-induced dermatomyositis secondary to ipilimumab therapy is a specific subtype of dermatomyositis, which is a broader class of disease.
Dermatomyositis is a broader class of disease that encompasses various subtypes, including those induced by drugs.
Drug-induced cutaneous eruption with myositis is a distinct condition that may not be directly related to dermatomyositis.
Immune checkpoint inhibitor-induced dermatomyositis is a specific subtype of dermatomyositis, which is equivalent to drug-induced dermatomyositis secondary to ipilimumab therapy.
